name: Miyazaki Rinka
source:
Third year student at St. Nympho's Academy. A member of the Bitch Club.

She has a rough and masculine personality, but she also has an older sisterly side that loves the main character as if he were her younger brother.

She is a power-type bitch. She is best friends with Miharu, but they always see each other as rivals.

She is such a manly girl, but she also has a surprising side to her...?
